proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection metadata/handshake and staged connect-accept flow, QP RTR/RTS setup, ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing, traffic-class handling, and receive-size completion behavior. Add gin because GIN-specific IB connect/accept/listen paths now use new cancellation/cleanup and FIFO-TC behavior, changing GIN integration logic. Add memory because MR registration switched to a per-device, reference-counted cache with new registration reuse and deregistration ownership semantics.
